title: 第7章 你爱青鸳我也爱青鸳我们是一伙的第8章 破案了破案了又破案了
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
姜云天脑袋像是受到了重创，有些昏昏沉沉，毕竞，几个强于他的神魂在他识海中激荡，他确实退出系统后，仔细想了想，还是从中得出不少信息，系统和四个死鬼看出了他的变化，可以说是脱胎换骨般的变化。
系统因此给他打开了全部系统功能，那说明以前的四个死鬼是没有过这种待遇的，这进一步反映出了这几天的变化巨大。
他也因此有了更强信心。
午后，姜云天不停地运功修炼，他感觉离突破到练气四重只有一丝，但他停下来了，他初来乍到，对修仙一途接近小白，还是明天问问青鸳比较踏实，这要是一个不查，搞出什么不可挽回的事，那对于他的修仙大业就有了影响了。
翌日一早，青鸳来到，看到姜云天和青儿穿戴整齐，打坐等待，满脸欣慰，想到昨日的情景，暗呸一口。
但她那羞愤的样子，看在姜云天眼里，内心也是一阵欢腾，这也怪不得姜云天，在蓝星时年轻时想找个女朋友，可是没有人待见他，因为太穷了，等年纪稍大，有积蓄有房，但别人又嫌弃他老。
你说这找谁说理去！
之后家在家村的他，被父母过年在老家大肆安排的相亲，他也都去了，可是却是无果而终，有些事情就是这样，不是你想怎么样，就会怎么样。
那些说要最好的年纪，遇到最好的伴侣的人，在姜云天看来，空想的成分太多。
他倒相信另一句话：“人生来所寻找的爱情，无非找到合适的另一半，但当你认为你找到了的时候，你却不知，你真正的另一半，在另一个角落里独自哭泣。”
青鸳对姜云天一阵感应，顿时一惊，本来想让他昨日巩固修为，没想到看到他丹田如此凝实，马上就要突破，看来她还是小看了那根树枝带给姜云天的变化。
暗一思忖，今天加点量试试？就这么愉顺快地决定了。
玉手一挥，结界立成，小手一翻，两个宝盒出现，打开一个宝盒，一颗土黄色的药丸出现在她手中，送入姜云天口中，姜云天也是轻车熟路，开始练化，一个半时辰以后，姜云天练化完成，修为练气五重巅峰，心下一喜，再看丹田中的小树苗，一个枝桠上开出一朵小黄花，娇艳欲滴。
这时青鸳说道，“继续打坐，巩固修为”
姜云天默默不语，开始运行周天，以巩固修为。
一个时辰以后，运行了九个周天以后，他觉得已经可以了，就停了下来，青鸳上前，认真感知姜云天的丹田，眉毛一挑，莞儿一笑，拿出另一个火红色的药丸，送到了姜云天口中。
入口之后，一股炽热向全身流动，姜云天一下就明白，第一颗是木属性的主生发，第二颗是土属性的温润。
这第三颗一定就是火属性的了。
第三天，随着第四颗水属性，第五颗金属性的药丸吸收完成，姜云天的修为已经达到练气九重圆满，这一刻他感觉自己有使不完的力量，巩固完修为他一个箭步冲到青鸳面前，青鸳刚要躲开，却下意识地停了一下，这几天他特意离姜云天有些距离，这小色胚前些日子一有机会就撩拨她几下，让她心乱如麻，今天停这一下，她也不知是不是心中的期待，还是心动了，总之，她就停了一下，小色胚就得手了，拉住了她。
青鸳怒道：“天儿，你这么大了，不要这样！”

一副凶人的样子，却没有呲牙狠劲。
像极了一只小奶狗。
姜云天是背对着青儿的，青鸳却是面对青儿的，她其实是想和姜云天亲近的，刚才差点就要倒在姜云天怀里，但是看到青儿，她忍住了，她要有基本的操守不是。
第四天，两个药丸，一黑一白，一同服下，在小树苗的吸收转化下，一阴一阳渐渐融合成一个旋转的图案，高悬于小树苗上方，若隐若现，而小树苗上的两根枝桠也开出了一黑一白两朵小花。
姜云天巩固练化完以后，发现自己并没突破，修为却大涨了，却没有达到筑基期，筑基期要形成气海，现在的情况和以前是不一样的，他也不能确定是不是到了筑基期，因为他是真的不知道是什么情况，只是以自身的感觉来判断了，对于一个修炼小白来说，凡是出现了不同的情况，都算是新情况了。
停止了修炼，姜云天睁开双眼，此时双眼精光大盛，已经和半个月前判若两人。
他伸开双臂，感觉自己的力量。
却听青鸳说道，“天儿，你要干吗？”
姜云天“当然”
青儿吃惊中...
青鸳，心中骂道“当呢玛个头，你不要脸，我还要呢”
迎上冲上来要抱自己了姜云天就是当胸一脚，姜云天倒飞出去，穿过门洞，撞在结界墙上，掉在地上激起阵阵尘土。
青儿还没从前面对话中跳出来，就看到姜云天飞出云的一幕，惊了个目瞪口呆。
青鸳这一脚也不是硬踹，而是使了软劲，不然这小子真得飞上天和天阳肩并肩了。
踢完这脚，青鸳没有解气的感觉，却忽然感到心痛了一下。
这个怨家啊。
在修仙界不同于凡人，对于动不动就是几千年上万年甚至是百万年的修行来说，辈份观念本就没那么重，只是青鸳百年来没有动过心，被老毕登洗脑了，不曾想被这个小色胚几次乱来，弄得她心烦意乱，以她的品性早就暴打一顿，抽身离开，可是心里被姜云天越撩越开心，但是又不能真的放开，毕竟是义女的孩子，她下不了手。
content_en:
Jiang Yuntian's head seemed to have been hit hard and he was a little dizzy. After all, several spirits stronger than him were stirring in his sea of ​​consciousness. After he did exit the system, he thought about it carefully and got a lot of information from it. The system and the four dead ghosts saw his change, which could be said to be a transformation.
The system therefore opened all system functions for him, which meant that the four dead ghosts had not received such treatment before, which further reflected the huge changes in the past few days.
He also gained greater confidence as a result.
In the afternoon, Jiang Yuntian kept practicing. He felt that he was only a few steps away from breaking through to the fourth level of Qi training, but he stopped. He was new here, and he was close to Xiaobai on the way to cultivating immortals. It would be more practical to ask Qingyuan tomorrow. If he didn't check and something irreversible happened, it would have an impact on his great cause of cultivating immortals.
Early the next morning, Qingyuan arrived and saw Jiang Yuntian and Qing'er dressed neatly, meditating and waiting. His face was full of joy. Thinking of yesterday's scene, he sighed secretly.
But seeing her shameful and angry look in Jiang Yuntian's eyes, there was a burst of joy in her heart. It's no wonder that Jiang Yuntian wanted to find a girlfriend when he was young in Blue Star, but no one wanted to see him because he was too poor. When he got older and had savings and a house, others despised him for being old.
Who are you going to talk to to reason with this?
Later, when he was living in the village, his parents arranged a lot of blind dates in his hometown during the Chinese New Year. He also went to all the blind dates, but they all ended in vain. Some things are just like this. It doesn't happen what you think.
Those who say they want to be at the best age and meet the best partner, in Jiang Yuntian's opinion, have too many elements of fantasy.
He believes in another sentence: "The love that people are looking for in life is nothing more than finding the right partner. But when you think you have found it, you don't know that your real partner is crying alone in another corner."
Qingyuan sensed Jiang Yuntian and was shocked. She originally wanted him to consolidate his cultivation yesterday, but she didn't expect to see his Dantian so solid that he was about to break through. It seemed that she had underestimated the changes that the branch had brought to Jiang Yuntian.
I thought to myself, will I try adding a little more today? It was decided so happily.
With a wave of her jade hand, the barrier was established, and with a flip of her little hand, two treasure boxes appeared. When she opened one of the treasure boxes, a khaki-yellow pill appeared in her hand and was put into Jiang Yuntian's mouth. Jiang Yuntian was also familiar with the process and began to practice. An hour and a half later, Jiang Yuntian completed the practice and reached the peak of the fifth level of Qi training. He was overjoyed. He looked at the sapling in the Dantian again. A small yellow flower bloomed on one branch, which was so delicate and charming.
At this time Qingyuan said, "Continue to meditate and consolidate your cultivation."
Jiang Yuntian remained silent and began to run Zhou Tian to consolidate his cultivation.
An hour later, after running for nine weeks, he felt that it was enough, so he stopped. Qingyuan stepped forward and carefully felt Jiang Yuntian's Dantian. He raised his eyebrows, smiled, took out another fiery red pill, and put it into Jiang Yuntian's mouth.
After the entrance, a blazing heat flowed throughout the body. Jiang Yuntian understood immediately that the first one was the main hair of the wood attribute, and the second one was the warmth of the earth attribute.
This third one must be of fire attribute.
On the third day, as the fourth water-based and fifth metallic pills were absorbed, Jiang Yuntian's cultivation had reached the ninth level of Qi training. At this moment, he felt that he had endless power. After consolidating his cultivation, he rushed to Qingyuan. Qingyuan was about to avoid it, but subconsciously stopped for a moment. Next, he deliberately kept some distance from Jiang Yuntian in the past few days. This little pervert teased her a few times whenever he had the chance, which made her feel confused. Today, when he stopped for a moment, she didn't know whether it was the expectation in her heart or her heart was moved. In short, she stopped for a moment, and the little pervert succeeded and held her.
Qingyuan said angrily: "Tian'er, you are so old, don't do this!"
He looked fierce, but he didn't yell.Teeth are strong.
Very much like a little puppy.
Jiang Yuntian's back was to Qing'er, but Qingyuan was facing Qing'er. She actually wanted to get close to Jiang Yuntian. She almost fell into Jiang Yuntian's arms just now, but when she saw Qing'er, she held back because she had to have basic ethics.
On the fourth day, two pills, one black and one white, were taken together. Under the absorption and transformation of the sapling, one yin and one yang gradually merged into a rotating pattern, hanging high above the sapling, looming, and two small flowers, one black and one white, bloomed on the two branches of the sapling.
After Jiang Yuntian consolidated and practiced, he found that he had not made a breakthrough, but his cultivation had greatly increased, but he had not reached the foundation building stage. During the foundation building stage, a sea of ​​​​qi was formed. The current situation was different from before. He was not sure whether he had reached the foundation building stage, because he really didn't know what the situation was, and he only judged it based on his own feelings. For a novice practitioner, any situation that occurs is considered a new situation.
After he stopped practicing, Jiang Yuntian opened his eyes. At this time, his eyes were so bright that he looked completely different from what he was half a month ago.
He stretched out his arms, feeling his strength.
But I heard Qingyuan say, "Tian'er, what do you want to do?"
Jiang Yuntian "Of course"
Qing'er was surprised...
Qingyuan cursed in his heart, "You are so shameless, I want you even more."
Jiang Yuntian rushed towards him and wanted to hug him. He kicked him in the chest. Jiang Yuntian flew out, passed through the doorway, hit the barrier wall, and fell to the ground, stirring up bursts of dust.
Before Qing'er could jump out of the previous conversation, she was stunned when she saw Jiang Yuntian flying out of the clouds.
Qingyuan's kick was not a hard kick, but a soft kick, otherwise this kid would have really flown into the sky and stood side by side with Tianyang.
After the kick, Qingyuan didn't feel relieved, but suddenly felt heartache.
This resentful family.
In the world of cultivating immortals, it is different from ordinary people. For a practice that can last for thousands, tens of thousands or even millions of years, the concept of generation is not that important. It’s just that Qingyuan has not been tempted in a hundred years. He was brainwashed by Old Biden and never wanted to be like this. The little pervert messed up several times, which made her upset. Given her character, she had already been beaten up and left. However, she felt happier and happier being teased by Jiang Yuntian, but she couldn't really let go. After all, it was her adopted daughter's child, so she couldn't do it.
